parallels.note: Truly, Yahweh, the kings of Assyria have laid waste the nations and their lands,

people.name: Assyria
people.line: A powerful ancient empire, often in conflict with Israel.

translations.web: Truly, Yahweh, the kings of Assyria have destroyed all the countries and their land,
translations.bsb: Truly, O LORD, the kings of Assyria have laid waste all these countries and their lands.
translations.kjv: Of a truth, LORD, the kings of Assyria have laid waste all the nations, and their countries,
translations.asv: Of a truth, Jehovah, the kings of Assyria have laid waste all the countries, and their land,
